title: Gaussian noise operator
statement: For a natural number $n$, a real parameter $\\rho$, a function $f:\\mathbb{R}^n\\to\\mathbb{R}$, and $x\\in\\mathbb{R}^n$, the Gaussian noise operator at $x$ is the Gaussian average of $f\\bigl(\\rho x+\\sqrt{1-\\rho^2}Y\\bigr)$, where $Y$ has independent standard Gaussian coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued function on Fin n → ℝ
A point x in Fin n → ℝ
